grant.eyebrow: AI eligibility analysis for the grant
grant.fillProfileBody: For grants, the applicant's eligibility (legal form, company size, registered seat) is key — without a profile, AI cannot assess it.
grant.intentLabel: What do you want to fund?
grant.intentPlaceholder: E.g. We want to buy a photovoltaic system for the production hall roof and a battery storage; estimated budget 120,000 €.
grant.intentHelp: If provided, AI will also assess whether the intent matches the call's objectives. Without it, only formal eligibility and financial feasibility are assessed.
grant.analyzeHelp: The analysis takes ~30 seconds. Split into 3 parts: formal eligibility, financial feasibility, what the call funds.
grant.trialCreditNote: Uses 1 of {{limit}} trial AI credits. The limit is shared between tenders and grants.
grant.trialExhaustedBody: You have used all {{limit}} AI analyses from the trial version. Grants and their AI analysis are part of the Komplet plan ({{price}}/mo, {{limit2}} analyses per month). The {{limit}} AI analyses limit is shared between tenders and grants.
grant.monthlyExhaustedBody: You have used up {{limit}} AI analyses this month. The quota will reset at the start of the next billing month.
grant.lockedNeedsUpgradeTitle: Grants are part of the Komplet plan
grant.lockedUpgradeBody: Grant calls, grant radars and AI eligibility assessment (legal form, region, funding) are part of the Komplet plan.
grant.lockedDemoBody: AI assesses formal eligibility, financial feasibility, and how well the intent matches the call's objectives.
grant.step1: 1. Formal eligibility (Gemini Pro) — legal form, region, sector
grant.step2: 2. Financial feasibility — co-financing rate vs. company turnover
grant.step3: 3. What the call funds (Gemini Flash) — activities, expenses, indicators
grant.step4: 4. Alignment of intent with the call's objectives
grant.trialExhaustedInline: You can still view the analysis, but the trial AI credits are exhausted.
grant.higherQuota: for a higher monthly analysis quota.
grant.webOnlyNote: You manage your subscription at tendrik.sk
grant.section1Desc: A binary gate: without being an eligible applicant (legal form, region, sector), you cannot participate in the call.
grant.section2Desc: Estimate of own contribution based on the co-financing rate, compared with the company's turnover.
grant.section4Title: 4. Alignment of your intent with the call
grant.intentSkipped: The intent was not assessed — the company is not an eligible applicant for the call.
grant.intentWhatToAdd: What to add to the intent:
grant.intentUnable: The alignment of the intent could not be assessed.
grant.editIntentPlaceholder: E.g. purchase of a photovoltaic system and battery storage…
grant.disclaimer: The analysis is indicative and AI-generated. Verify the conditions in the official call.
grant.financeUnknown: Cannot be assessed (add financial years in /firma)

tender.fillProfileBody: So that AI can compare the contract's conditions with your company, we need at least a company ID and basic details.
tender.analyzeHelp: The analysis takes ~30 seconds. The result is saved and loads instantly the next time you open it.
tender.trialCreditNote: This analysis uses 1 of {{limit}} trial AI credits (also covers subcontracting and outreach for the same contract).
tender.trialExhaustedBody: You have used all {{limit}} AI analyses from the trial version. Choose a plan with AI – Premium ({{premiumPrice}}/mo, {{premiumLimit}} analyses per month) or Komplet ({{kompletPrice}}/mo, {{kompletLimit}} analyses + grants).
tender.monthlyExhaustedBody: You have used up {{limit}} AI analyses this month. The quota will reset at the start of the next billing month, or upgrade to a higher plan.
tender.alreadySavedNote: You can still view analyses that have already been generated.
tender.lockedNeedsUpgradeTitle: AI analysis is part of the Premium and Komplet plans
tender.lockedUpgradeBody: The Basic plan gives you monitoring, radars and notifications. AI comparison of conditions with your company (eligibility, subcontracting) is part of Premium and Komplet.
tender.lockedDemoBody: AI compares the participation conditions with your company and tells you whether it's worth applying.
tender.step3: 3. Comparison with your company profile (Gemini Pro)
tender.trialExhaustedInline: You can still view the analysis, but the trial AI credits are exhausted.
tender.higherQuota: for a higher monthly analysis quota.
tender.webOnlyNote: You manage your subscription at tendrik.sk
tender.mostlyUnspecifiedNote: Most conditions are "not specified". Detailed conditions are usually in the tender documentation (PDF attachments), which is not part of the public description. This analysis is based on the available contract text.
tender.disclaimer: The analysis is indicative and AI-generated. Verify the conditions in the official notice.
tender.tedLanguageNote: The text is in the original language ({{language}}). The AI analysis below will process it in Slovak.
tender.tedInAttachmentsBody: The TED notice states that the detailed participation conditions are in the tender documentation (attachments), not in the notice itself. The AI analysis works with the description below; exact conditions can be found in the attached documentation.

subcontracting.whatToSecureBody: Based on the contract's conditions and your profile, AI suggests items you likely need a subcontractor or partner for.
subcontracting.selfSufficientTitle: The company can likely handle everything on its own.
subcontracting.noCompaniesFound: We didn't find any companies by registered activity (tried: {{tried}}{{cityNote}}). Adjust the search term above and try again, or add your own company.
subcontracting.tip: Tip: registered activities are often worded generically. Use a short word stem (e.g. "garden", "municipal equipment", "electrician") instead of the whole phrase.
subcontracting.addCustomButton: Add your own company for this item
subcontracting.noneSelected: No one has been selected yet.
subcontracting.footerDisclaimer: Subcontracting and company suggestions are indicative, generated by AI from public registers (RPO ŠÚ SR). Verify references, capacity and reliability yourself. Tendrik does not send outreach messages — send them from your own mailbox.
subcontracting.toastKeywordTooShort: Enter at least 2 characters for the search term.
subcontracting.toastAddedEmpty: Added empty — fill in a company for "{{need}}"
subcontracting.toastAddedManual: Empty entry added – fill in the company details below.
subcontracting.toastFillFields: Fill in the item, company and specification.
subcontracting.contactEmailPlaceholder: for your own use, never sent anywhere
subcontracting.specificationLabel: Specification – what you want from them
